people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
translations.bsb: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
translations.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
translations.asv: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!
